channel.title: ShopNow Kitchen guides
channel.description: Kitchen gear, explained like a friend would. Every claim traced to its source.

item.title: Holiday cooking: what one countertop oven holds
item.description: A planning checklist for running a holiday meal through a 26-quart countertop air fryer oven: the manufacturer's capacity and serving statements, outside dimensions, the USDA temperatures that do not bend, and instant-read versus leave-in probes.

item.title: 24 presets or 25? How to read a preset list
item.description: Why preset counts and function counts are not comparable between air fryers, worked through the Emeril Lagasse 26 QT French Door oven, whose own pages state 24 and 25 presets and 10-in-1 and 11-in-1.

item.title: Sync Finish and Hi-Fry: what the buttons do
item.description: What Sync Finish, Hi-Fry and independent baskets mean on the Chefman dual-basket air fryer, read from the manufacturer page and the Amazon listing, including the disputed temperature ceiling on the 8 qt model.

item.title: What “NIST certified” means on a thermometer
item.description: A plain-English read of the claims on a thermometer listing - NIST certification, plus or minus half a degree, an IP rating - set against what USDA FSIS says about typical accuracy and about where to put the probe.

item.title: Which air fryer parts are actually dishwasher-safe?
item.description: What the five products we track say about dishwasher-safe parts: which component each claim covers, which pages stay silent, and what to check in the manual before you load anything.

item.title: Is your meat thermometer telling you the right number?
item.description: How to use a meat thermometer so the reading means something: USDA target temperatures, probe placement, calibration checks, and what wireless specs like range and probe count really buy you.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: A buyer's interrogation guide for combination air fryers, toaster ovens and other multi-function appliances: counting real functions, presets, accessories and the learning curve.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: A practical method for weighing dishwasher claims, hand-washing reality, counter footprint, ventilation clearance and open-door space before you buy a kitchen appliance.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: What quart ratings measure, what they leave out, and a printable checklist of questions to compare air fryer capacity without the marketing gloss.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: A plain-English comparison of basket-style and oven-style air fryers: what each shape does well, what to check before you choose, and how the appliances we track blur the line.
